name: Face Pulls with Wrist Cuffs
nameDa: Face pulls med håndledsmanchetter i kabel
aliases: Cable face pull with wrist cuffs
movementPattern: Shoulder horizontal abduction and external rotation
grip: Hands relaxed in padded wrist cuffs fastened around the wrists, with tension applied directly to D-rings.
description: Perform high-cable face pulls using padded wrist cuffs rather than handles, eliminating forearm grip fatigue and isolating shoulder external rotation and rear deltoid recruitment.
setup: Attach dual cables or a split cable to a high pulley set around eye or forehead height.
Fasten padded wrist cuffs securely around both wrists and attach them to the cable carabiners.
Step back into a stable staggered stance with arms extended forward and upward toward the pulley, hands relaxed.
instructions: Initiate the pull by drawing your elbows backward and outward at eye level.
Externally rotate your shoulders as your hands approach your face, finishing with hands beside your temples/ears.
Keep hands and fingers completely relaxed inside the cuffs so the tension pulls through the wrists.
Pause for a second at peak contraction, squeezing rear deltoids and external rotators.
Slowly extend your arms back toward the pulley under control.
cues: Lead with the elbows high and wide.
Rotate shoulders outward at the finish.
commonMistakes: Clenching fists or trying to grip the straps, negating cuff benefits.
Dropping elbows low into a row instead of keeping them at eye level.
Leaning the torso backward to use bodyweight.
